Bash(rm -f /tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db
OPENPANEL__SERVER__PORT=18443 OPENPANEL__DATABASE__URL=/tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db RUST_LOG=info ./target/debug/openpanel serve 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 3
echo "--- health ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18443/health
echo ""
echo "--- create user ---"
./target/debug/openpanel --config /tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db user create --username admin --email admin@example.com --password 'correct horse battery staple' --role owner 2>&1 || OPENPANEL__SERVER__PORT=18443 OPENPANEL__DATABASE__URL=/tmp/openpanel-test/openpanel.db ./target/debug/openpanel user create --username admin --email admin@example.com --password 'correct horse battery staple' --role owner
echo ""
echo "--- login ---"
LOGIN_RESP=$\(curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18443/api/v1/identity/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username_or_email":"admin","password":"correct horse battery staple"}'\)
echo "$LOGIN_RESP"
echo ""
echo "--- list users ---"
TOKEN=$\(echo "$LOGIN_RESP" | grep -o '"token":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4\)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:18443/api/v1/identity/users
echo ""
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
echo "done")
